obligation: Forward realization and attachment transport, before readout descent

native_candidate.map: Continuous map, isometric on every whole source cell, onto whole target cells, with shared vertices and full shared faces agreeing
native_candidate.hostile: A source octahedron must map to one of the target octahedra. Test every root octahedral symmetry. Unlike tetrahedron/octahedron neighbours cannot fold onto the same target cell; a target face has at most one owner of each kind. Consequently propagation fixes the same rigid frame across the face-connected source.
not_allowed: mapping an octahedron to a tetrahedron

piecewise_affine_candidate.branches: sign(u), sign(v); each branch is a tetrahedron with the two w poles and one pole from each remaining pair
piecewise_affine_candidate.pole_assignment: u+ -> corner0, u- -> corner1, v+ -> corner2, v- -> corner3; w+ -> midpoint01, w- -> midpoint23
piecewise_affine_candidate.transport: Keep each original cell ID, role and all chart fragments. P/E duality is conjugated through the map, never inferred from target coordinate colours.
piecewise_affine_candidate.metric_transport: For each affine matrix A in three independent coordinates, use A^(-T) (I + 11^T) A^(-1) to retain source lengths. This is not the native ESD7 Euclidean metric.
hostiles: pretending half-integer target points are native ESD7 nodes
pretending a deformed native edge retains its original Euclidean length

common_refinement_continuation.introduced_after: The first 20 envelope/native-frame checks; their receipt is retained separately as envelope-phase-verification.json
common_refinement_continuation.operation: Intersect each mapped affine chart fragment with every overlapping native ESD7 cell. Retain source cell ID, source role, chart, target cell ID and exact intersection geometry.
tests: exact full volume in every native target cell
exact full mapped volume for every original source cell
fragment deletion violates source and target coverage
common_refinement_continuation.not_claimed: A single P/N/E label per target cell, unit-metric source-cell preservation, a quotient of physical modes, or a particle-count reduction.

scope: Finite geometry and retained records only. Neither candidate supplies phase/witness dynamics, particle modes, stability, or 82/126/82. A piecewise-affine homeomorphism to the ESD7 envelope is not a whole-cell native ESD7 realization.
